extraction_plan: Prioritize sections s11, s12, and s13 for I2C transaction details: extract the slave address rule, addressing bytes, write-cycle behavior, random/sequential read flow, and any polling/busy status constraints. Use s10 to capture overall device behavior, especially memory access model and any operational caveats. From s2 and s6 extract pin assignments to ensure the correct SDA/SCL and power connections. From s5, s7, and s8 capture electrical and timing limits relevant to safe operation, including voltage ranges, bus timing, and write-cycle timing. Ignore ordering and package-mechanical sections for driver code, except as variant-selection context if needed.
extraction_notes: This device is an AT24C256 I2C EEPROM, so the most important driver inputs are address decoding, write sequence, read sequence, and timing/polling behavior after writes. The document likely has no register map in the MCU-sensor sense; treat memory-address and command-like details as target fields under registers_or_commands only where the datasheet specifies device commands or address bytes. If a section only contains package, ordering, or revision information, exclude it from implementation logic. Extract any explicit page size, memory size, and write-protect behavior if present in the prose under operation/write/read sections, even though those are not separately listed as categories.
